Five Star Business Finance Submits Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY 2025-26 just now Five Star Business Finance Limited submitted its BRSR for FY 2025-26, disclosing operations across 844 offices in 10 states with a total workforce of 14,159 employees and a turnover of INR 324,597 lakhs. Environmental metrics show total non-renewable energy consumption of 11,659.81 GJ, Scope 1 emissions of 3.64 tCO2e, Scope 2 emissions of 2,289.93 tCO2e, and water consumption of 179,040.56 kilolitres for the year. Customer complaints totalled 956 in FY 2025-26 with 151 pending at year-end, while no human rights or POSH complaints were reported. The company's CSR activities spanned education, healthcare, skill development, and community conservation across 40 NGOs and trusts, including INR 6,066,000.00 spent in the aspirational district of Virudhunagar, Tamil Nadu. Independent reasonable assurance for BRSR core indicators was provided by SGS India Pvt. Ltd

Sayaji Hotels (Pune) appoints Isha Garg as independent director just now Sayaji Hotels (Pune) Limited has appointed Mrs. Isha Garg as an Additional Non-Executive Independent Director, effective August 6, 2026. The Board approved the appointment during its meeting, noting her extensive experience as a practicing Company Secretary with expertise in corporate law and compliance. Her tenure is subject to shareholder approval via Special Resolution at the ensuing General Meeting or for a period of three months from the date of appointment, whichever is earlier. The appointment was disclosed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations
